quote.exact_quote:
I’ve used the same moisturizer for the last 5 years. To be honest, I’ve always viewed moisturizers as a check-the-box item in my skincare routine. How special can they be??? Well, this moisturizer has proven me wrong!! 

I bought Instant Angel on an impulse after I saw a friend raving about it online. I started using it morning and night and initially it caused small pimples on my cheeks and nose, but I think that was because my skin was not used to such a rich moisturizer. After about a week of use, my skin absolutely transformed!! There’s a reason they call this Instant Angel. My skin is silky soft and supple, I’ve seen improvements in fine lines on my forehead, and I swear I’m *glowing*!

The metal tube packaging is unique and looks pretty on my vanity. I will say, I can anticipate the packaging being annoying once the product gets low. 

So happy I tried this!
